parsed.reason: Description A says the removed mark_as_failure call means invalid-ETA tasks never get a FAILURE state in the result backend. Description B says the handler does not return after rejecting, so the task falls through and executes immediately ignoring its ETA; it also mentions the missing result-backend failure but as a secondary effect. The primary defects differ: A is about missing result-backend recording, while B is about missing early return causing execution despite rejection. Different root causes/failures at the same location.
